_comment: Single source of truth for error codes (Constitution Parts 12.3, 12.4, 22.8, 42.2).
Application code raises codes from this registry only. The four-part
operator error screen (Part 22.8) is assembled from these fields, which is
what makes non-technical error design a build-time guarantee.
preserves_history: true means trusted history and the last approved
dashboard are untouched — the operator must always be told this (Part 12.6).

codes.operator_message_en: A required source file was not found.
codes.operator_message_ar: لم يتم العثور على أحد الملفات المطلوبة.
codes.next_action: Add the missing file and press Retry.

codes.operator_message_en: The file is still being copied or written.
codes.operator_message_ar: لا يزال الملف قيد النسخ أو الكتابة.
codes.next_action: Wait for the copy to finish; the application retries automatically.

codes.operator_message_en: Microsoft Excel is not available on this computer.
codes.operator_message_ar: برنامج مايكروسوفت إكسل غير متاح على هذا الجهاز.
codes.next_action: Contact IT: Excel desktop is a required prerequisite.

codes.operator_message_en: The workbook could not be opened automatically.
codes.operator_message_ar: تعذر فتح المصنف تلقائيًا.
codes.next_action: The application will try again, then ask you to open it manually.

codes.operator_message_en: More than one open workbook has a similar name.
codes.operator_message_ar: يوجد أكثر من مصنف مفتوح بأسماء متشابهة.
codes.next_action: Close the workbooks you are not reporting on, then press Retry.

codes.operator_message_en: This protected file must be opened by you first.
codes.operator_message_ar: يجب أن تفتح هذا الملف المحمي بنفسك أولاً.
codes.next_action: Open the file in Excel, confirm you can see the data, leave it open, then press Retry.

codes.operator_message_en: Reading the data from Excel was interrupted.
codes.operator_message_ar: تمت مقاطعة قراءة البيانات من إكسل.
codes.next_action: The run resumes from its last checkpoint. Keep the workbook open.

codes.operator_message_en: A required column is missing from the source file.
codes.operator_message_ar: عمود مطلوب غير موجود في الملف المصدر.
codes.next_action: Open the quality report to see the exact column name, then confirm the change with the file owner.

codes.operator_message_en: A critical column changed its type.
codes.operator_message_ar: تغير نوع بيانات عمود مهم.
codes.next_action: Review schema_diff.json with the file owner before loading.

codes.operator_message_en: The same record appears more than once in the source.
codes.operator_message_ar: نفس السجل يظهر أكثر من مرة في الملف المصدر.
codes.next_action: Open the quality report to see the duplicated keys.

codes.operator_message_en: The totals in the source file and the database do not match. Your previous dashboard is unchanged and still correct.
codes.operator_message_ar: الإجماليات في الملف المصدر وقاعدة البيانات غير متطابقة. لوحتك السابقة لم تتغير وما زالت صحيحة.
codes.next_action: Open the quality report to see which source and column differ.

codes.operator_message_en: This report still has business rules waiting for approval.
codes.operator_message_ar: لا تزال هناك قواعد عمل بانتظار الاعتماد لهذا التقرير.
codes.next_action: The report owner must approve the open definitions before a production run.

codes.operator_message_en: There is not enough free disk space to process safely.
codes.operator_message_ar: لا توجد مساحة كافية على القرص لإتمام المعالجة بأمان.
codes.next_action: Free disk space, then press Retry.

codes.operator_message_en: This file is too large to process with the memory available.
codes.operator_message_ar: هذا الملف كبير جدًا بالنسبة للذاكرة المتاحة.
codes.next_action: Close other applications and press Retry, or contact support.

codes.operator_message_en: This report is already being processed.
codes.operator_message_ar: تتم معالجة هذا التقرير بالفعل.
codes.next_action: Wait for the current run to finish.

codes.operator_message_en: Part of the application is missing or damaged.
codes.operator_message_ar: جزء من التطبيق مفقود أو تالف.
codes.next_action: Run SETUP_OFFLINE.bat to restore the application from its sealed repair copy.

codes.operator_message_en: Part of the application was blocked by this computer's security software.
codes.operator_message_ar: تم حظر جزء من التطبيق بواسطة برنامج الحماية على هذا الجهاز.
codes.next_action: Give the support code to IT; the application will not run a reduced version.

codes.operator_message_en: This installation does not match its approved version.
codes.operator_message_ar: هذه النسخة لا تطابق الإصدار المعتمد.
codes.next_action: Give the support code to IT and reinstall the approved release.

codes.operator_message_en: The application tried to use the internet, which is not allowed.
codes.operator_message_ar: حاول التطبيق استخدام الإنترنت، وهذا غير مسموح.
codes.next_action: Give the support code to IT. Do not continue using this build.

codes.operator_message_en: The application could not start its local connection.
codes.operator_message_ar: تعذر على التطبيق بدء الاتصال المحلي.
codes.next_action: Give the support code to IT: local loopback access is being blocked by endpoint policy.

codes.operator_message_en: A request came from an unexpected source and was refused.
codes.operator_message_ar: تم رفض طلب وارد من مصدر غير متوقع.
codes.next_action: Close other browser tabs and reopen the application from START_APP.bat.

codes.operator_message_en: The application could not verify its own connection safely.
codes.operator_message_ar: تعذر على التطبيق التحقق من سلامة اتصاله.
codes.next_action: Close the application completely and start it again from START_APP.bat.

codes.operator_message_en: The application asked for administrator rights, which it must never need.
codes.operator_message_ar: طلب التطبيق صلاحيات المسؤول، وهو أمر لا يجب أن يحدث أبدًا.
codes.next_action: Do not approve the prompt. Give the support code to IT; this is a packaging defect.

codes.operator_message_en: The database could not be updated. Your previous data is unchanged.
codes.operator_message_ar: تعذر تحديث قاعدة البيانات. بياناتك السابقة لم تتغير.
codes.next_action: Check free disk space, then give the support code to IT if it repeats.

codes.operator_message_en: The update was cancelled and rolled back. Your trusted history is unchanged.
codes.operator_message_ar: تم إلغاء التحديث والتراجع عنه. سجلك الموثوق لم يتغير.
codes.next_action: Retry the run. If it repeats, give the support code to IT.

codes.operator_message_en: The central database is not reachable. Your local report is complete and correct.
codes.operator_message_ar: قاعدة البيانات المركزية غير متاحة. تقريرك المحلي مكتمل وصحيح.
codes.next_action: No action needed. Sharing will retry automatically.

codes.operator_message_en: Sending data to the central database did not finish.
codes.operator_message_ar: لم يكتمل إرسال البيانات إلى قاعدة البيانات المركزية.
codes.next_action: No action needed. The pending item retries automatically.

codes.operator_message_en: Local and central totals do not agree.
codes.operator_message_ar: الإجماليات المحلية والمركزية غير متطابقة.
codes.next_action: Give the support code to the database owner. Sharing is paused until it is resolved.

codes.operator_message_en: A calculation check failed, so no new numbers were published.
codes.operator_message_ar: فشل أحد فحوص الحساب، لذلك لم يتم نشر أرقام جديدة.
codes.next_action: Your previous dashboard is still shown. Give the support code to support.

codes.operator_message_en: The dashboard data did not pass its format check.
codes.operator_message_ar: لم تجتز بيانات اللوحة فحص التنسيق.
codes.next_action: Your previous dashboard is still shown. Give the support code to support.

codes.operator_message_en: The new dashboard could not be built.
codes.operator_message_ar: تعذر إنشاء اللوحة الجديدة.
codes.next_action: Your previous dashboard is still shown. Retry, then contact support.

codes.operator_message_en: The new dashboard did not pass its automatic checks, so it was not published.
codes.operator_message_ar: لم تجتز اللوحة الجديدة الفحوص التلقائية، لذلك لم يتم نشرها.
codes.next_action: Your previous dashboard is still shown and still correct. Contact support with the code.
